get.summary: The systems a device runs and the state of each action

400.description:
Malformed request (invalid_request)

- invalid_request: deviceId is not a UUID

401.description:
API key missing or wrong (unauthenticated)

- unauthenticated: the API key is missing or wrong

403.description:
Organisation not approved yet (partner_not_approved)

- partner_not_approved: the key belongs to an organisation that Deepdock has not approved yet

404.description:
Device not found (device_not_found)

- device_not_found: no device of this key has that id

409.description:
The device cannot take the call (device_outdated, device_learning_only, device_connected_twice)

- device_outdated: the device runs a Deepdock client too old for this call; update it, then retry
- device_learning_only: this PC runs the Deepdock client for learning only; install the Deepdock service on it, then retry
- device_connected_twice: two PCs are connected with this device identity (a copied PC or VM snapshot); shut the copy down, calls work again about five minutes after only one is connected

429.description:
Too many requests (rate_limited)

- rate_limited: too many calls with this key in the last minute; wait for Retry-After seconds (retryAfterSeconds in the body) and retry

500.description:
Internal error (internal_error)

- internal_error: internal error; requestId names the request for support

503.description:
Device cannot take the call now (device_offline, temporarily_unavailable)

- device_offline: the device is not connected, did not answer in time, or the call was cut off inside Deepdock; retry after the Retry-After seconds
- temporarily_unavailable: the key or our database could not be checked because of an outage on our side; retry after the Retry-After seconds

requestId.description: With a 500: names the request for support

systems.description: With system_not_on_device: the systems this device reported or was assigned

version.description: With system_version_unverified: the version the system last reported

reason.description: With system_version_unverified: unverified_version, or unparseable when the reported version is not dotted digits
